tools.name: explore_designs
tools.description: Lists 8B site designs: the look, the structure and the kinds of business each one suits. Use it to choose the design for the user's site.

tools.name: get_design_brief
tools.description: Returns the brief for writing the site in a design: every text with a hint and max length, the color palette, fonts and photos. Write them for the user's business and pass the values to generate_site.

language.description: Language of the site you are making, e.g. "ru" or "en": the word limits are adjusted to it

tools.name: generate_site
tools.description: Generates the user's site with 8B from a design and the texts, colors, fonts and photo queries written for the business, and shows a live, animated preview in the conversation. Call get_design_brief first to see the fields. Returns the preview id, the preview link and the link to download the site. To change a site that is already built (a color, some texts, a photo), call it with base_preview_id and only the values that change: everything else is kept.

base_preview_id.description: To change an existing preview: its id. Send only the values that change; the rest is taken from that preview

design_id.description: Design id from explore_designs. Required for a new site, not needed with base_preview_id

site_name.description: Name of the business or project the site is for. Required for a new site

language.description: Language of the site, e.g. "ru" or "de", the same as for get_design_brief. Not needed with base_preview_id

texts.description: New text per field id from get_design_brief

colors.description: New CSS color per palette id

fonts.description: Current font family → new Google Fonts family spec

images.description: Image id → {query: English Unsplash search query, alt: photo description in the site language}. Photos of the same kind share one query; each place gets a different photo
